package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/kaspanet/kaspad/cmd/kaspawallet/libkaspawallet/bip32"
	"github.com/kaspanet/kaspad/cmd/kaspawallet/libkaspawallet/serialization"
	"github.com/kaspanet/kaspad/domain/consensus/model/externalapi"
	"github.com/kaspanet/kaspad/domain/consensus/utils/subnetworks"
)

// Cosigner-level extended public key (testnet ktub version) sourced
// verbatim from cmd/kaspawallet/tests/fixtures/legacy_go_v1_singlekey.json
// -- the same cosigner xpub the keyfile-decryption tests use.
const cosignerExtendedPublicKey = "ktub249YJayoDJS3tDjTW8NG3iAwufiDQ13uEptr8Wz2LgnzdVFLUQiRqFRPyq1xndcJMXFbYx268MSxHwukrnD52gWeshgeYseLmTBcUNHR1Xb"

// Relative derivation path applied to the cosigner xpub. The Go
// kaspawallet daemon's walletAddressPath() emits this exact form for
// single-signer wallets (m/<keyChain>/<index>) at
// https://github.com/kaspanet/kaspad/blob/4bb5bf25d3f2279ec2a61c3b4f7bb083b5f522b2/cmd/kaspawallet/daemon/server/address.go#L116
// and libkaspawallet.CreateUnsignedTransaction stores it on the
// PartiallySignedInput.DerivationPath unchanged
// (transaction.go:127).
const relativeDerivationPath = "m/0/0"

func main() {
	cosignerKey, err := bip32.DeserializeExtendedKey(cosignerExtendedPublicKey)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "deserialize cosigner xpub:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	leafKey, err := cosignerKey.DeriveFromPath(relativeDerivationPath)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "derive leaf:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	leafExtendedPublicKey := leafKey.String()
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "leaf xpub:", leafExtendedPublicKey)

	var prevHash [externalapi.DomainHashSize]byte
	for i := 0; i < externalapi.DomainHashSize; i++ {
		prevHash[i] = byte(i + 1)
	}
	prevID := externalapi.NewDomainTransactionIDFromByteArray(&prevHash)

	scriptVer := &externalapi.ScriptPublicKey{
		Script: []byte{
			0xaa, 0x20, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44, 0x55, 0x66, 0x77, 0x88,
			0x99, 0xaa, 0xbb, 0xcc, 0xdd, 0xee, 0xff, 0x00,
			0xde, 0xad, 0xbe, 0xef, 0xfe, 0xed, 0xfa, 0xce,
			0xca, 0xfe, 0xba, 0xbe, 0xa5, 0xa5, 0xa5, 0xa5, 0x87,
		},
		Version: 0,
	}

	prevOutput := &externalapi.DomainTransactionOutput{
		Value:           500000000,
		ScriptPublicKey: scriptVer,
	}

	tx := &externalapi.DomainTransaction{
		Version: 0,
		Inputs: []*externalapi.DomainTransactionInput{
			{
				PreviousOutpoint: externalapi.DomainOutpoint{TransactionID: *prevID, Index: 1},
				SignatureScript:  []byte{},
				Sequence:         0xffffffffffffffff,
				SigOpCount:       1,
			},
		},
		Outputs: []*externalapi.DomainTransactionOutput{
			{
				Value: 250000000,
				ScriptPublicKey: &externalapi.ScriptPublicKey{
					Script: []byte{
						0x20, 0xaa, 0xbb, 0xcc, 0xdd, 0xee, 0xff, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33,
						0x44, 0x55, 0x66, 0x77, 0x88, 0x99, 0x00, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33,
						0x44, 0x55, 0x66, 0x77, 0x88, 0x99, 0xaa, 0xbb, 0xcc, 0xdd,
						0xee, 0xff, 0x00, 0xac,
					},
					Version: 0,
				},
			},
			{
				Value: 249990000,
				ScriptPublicKey: &externalapi.ScriptPublicKey{
					Script: []byte{
						0x20, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44, 0x55, 0x66, 0x77, 0x88, 0x99,
						0xaa, 0xbb, 0xcc, 0xdd, 0xee, 0xff, 0x00, 0x99, 0x88, 0x77,
						0x66, 0x55, 0x44, 0x33, 0x22, 0x11, 0xab, 0xcd, 0xef, 0x12,
						0x34, 0x56, 0x78, 0xac,
					},
					Version: 0,
				},
			},
		},
		LockTime:     0,
		SubnetworkID: subnetworks.SubnetworkIDNative,
		Gas:          0,
		Payload:      []byte{},
	}

	pst := &serialization.PartiallySignedTransaction{
		Tx: tx,
		PartiallySignedInputs: []*serialization.PartiallySignedInput{
			{
				PrevOutput:        prevOutput,
				MinimumSignatures: 1,
				PubKeySignaturePairs: []*serialization.PubKeySignaturePair{
					{ExtendedPublicKey: leafExtendedPublicKey, Signature: nil},
				},
				DerivationPath: relativeDerivationPath,
			},
		},
	}

	bytes, err := serialization.SerializePartiallySignedTransaction(pst)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "serialize:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println(hex.EncodeToString(bytes))
}
